reason: The cited code reads a Git commit and its patch from a local repo object and returns commit metadata, message, paths, and diff text, so it can expose repository/host data into the agent context. Those commit messages, paths, and diffs are repository contents and may be controlled by whoever authored or supplied the repo/commit, so the returned text is untrusted. The lines do not show arbitrary host code execution, and they do not send agent-supplied data to any external or attacker-readable destination.
